messages.author: FikusMikus
messages.text:
Right now each building’s workforce slots are tied to specific education levels, and the hiring routine matches workers to those slots by their education — it does not let a college‑educated worker fill a “uneducated” slot or a high‑school slot replace a college requirement. 

I propose a change to the system, allowing higher education pops fill jobs with lower education requirements so long as no better job is available.

This change would remove a lot of friction coming from demographics and create a more realistic system in which educated people dont simply refuse to work.

messages.author: Andrew
messages.text: Let us put people who choose not to work into the infantry first.
